diff --git a/game.py b/game.py
index 0d37edb..947da2b 100644
--- a/game.py
+++ b/game.py
@@ -27,5 +27,11 @@ def record_win(game, player):
 
 
 def reset_round(game):
-    """Get the game ready for another round."""
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    """Get the game ready for another round.
+
+    Clears the board and move count and gives the first player the turn.
+    Scores and players are kept, so nothing is lost between rounds.
+    """
+    game["board"][:] = [EMPTY] * 9
+    game["moves"] = 0
+    game["turn"] = game["players"][0]
diff --git a/tests/test_game.py b/tests/test_game.py
index 07b9087..0818430 100644
--- a/tests/test_game.py
+++ b/tests/test_game.py
@@ -28,3 +28,25 @@ def test_record_win():
     s = g.new_game()
     g.record_win(s, "O")
     assert s["scores"] == {"X": 0, "O": 1}
+
+
+def test_reset_round_clears_board_and_keeps_scores():
+    s = g.new_game()
+    g.play(s, 0)
+    g.play(s, 4)
+    g.play(s, 1)
+    g.record_win(s, "X")
+    g.reset_round(s)
+    assert s["board"] == [g.EMPTY] * 9
+    assert s["moves"] == 0
+    assert s["turn"] == "X"
+    assert s["scores"] == {"X": 1, "O": 0}
+    assert s["players"] == ["X", "O"]
+
+
+def test_reset_round_allows_replaying_a_cell():
+    s = g.new_game()
+    g.play(s, 0)
+    g.reset_round(s)
+    g.play(s, 0)
+    assert s["board"][0] == "X"
